set.acceptance: A test resumes an interrupted run on an accepted change set, and one on a landed change set whose non-plan run reached its land step; it leaves interrupted runs unresumed on landed change sets that never reached land, and on rejected, withdrawn, proposed and draft change sets
set.statement: The daemon resumes an interrupted run only while its change set is accepted, or, for a non-plan run that reached its land step, landed (daemon-resumes-landed-past-land)

set.acceptance: A test with an interrupted run on a landed change set whose journal never reached land lists it in rhiza inbox with the state and the abandon command, and the daemon does not resume it
set.statement: An interrupted run on a change set no longer accepted waits in the inbox, naming the change set's state and rhiza run abandon as the next step, except a non-plan run on a landed change set whose journal reached its land step, which the daemon resumes (inbox-omits-resumable-landed-run, daemon-resumes-landed-past-land)

The daemon resumes an interrupted run whose change set is accepted, or a non-plan run on a landed change set whose journal reached its land step (daemon-resumes-landed-past-land), once, as a detached rhiza run resume --foreground <run> process outside Rex (daemon-headless-run-drivers), and journals that resume in the run's journal; it leaves alone an interrupted run whose change set is not accepted (outside that exception), a run interrupted again after that resume, which the inbox lists as a run the daemon gave up on, and every failed run, which the inbox lists as failed.
